package service

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for service_returns_tx_to_caller: Services that hand transaction objects back to handlers or controllers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type TransferService struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewTransferService(db *gorm.DB) *TransferService {
	return &TransferService{db: db}
}

func (s *TransferService) BeginTx() *gorm.DB {
	return s.db.Begin()
}

func (s *TransferService) Debit(tx *gorm.DB, accountID string, amount float64) error {
	return tx.Exec("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ?", amount, accountID).Error
}

func (s *TransferService) Credit(tx *gorm.DB, accountID string, amount float64) error {
	return tx.Exec("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + ? WHERE id = ?", amount, accountID).Error
}
